rows.label: bf04320100_0010
rows.name: Professor Tatezou, give us instructions already.

rows.label: bf04320100_0020
rows.name:
If production falls any further behind,
I can't guarantee your life.

rows.label: bf04320100_0030
rows.name: Reduce the neural circuit load by 20%, mo.

rows.label: bf04320100_0050
rows.name:
You should have cooperated
from the start.

rows.label: bf04320100_0090
rows.name: Y-you are[ML:Dash ] Tora, is that you, mo?

rows.label: bf04320100_0100
rows.name: Dad Tatezou[ML:Dash ] is that you, mo?

rows.label: bf04320100_0130
rows.name: I wanted to see you, mo!

rows.label: bf04320100_0190
rows.name: Tora's companions[ML:Dash ] I mean, friends, mo.

rows.label: bf04320100_0200
rows.name:
I see. They came all this way[ML:Dash ]
You've got good friends, mo.

rows.label: bf04320100_0220
rows.name:
This is Hana, mo. Tora made her by improving
Kiku's blueprints, mo.

rows.label: bf04320100_0230
rows.name: Oh, wonderful. Tora, you've worked hard, mo.

rows.label: bf04320100_0240
rows.name:
Everyone, I'm sure you have much to talk
about, but let's focus on escaping first.

rows.label: bf04320100_0300
rows.name: My, my. You hadn't noticed, mo?

rows.label: bf04320100_0310
rows.name:
I deliberately leaked the information
to lure you here, mo.

rows.label: bf04320100_0320
rows.name:
Otherwise, there's no way you could've found
this place so easily, mo.

rows.label: bf04320100_0330
rows.name: You[ML:Dash ] I won't forgive you, mo!

rows.label: bf04320100_0350
rows.name:
Hmph. I've been waiting for a chance
to get that artificial Blade, mo.
